verified_by_archive.what: The three cited Zenodo/GitHub items are independently checkable against the archive's own record of the same termination event.
verified_by_archive.detail: Issues #2606 and #2596 on zenodo/zenodo are the threads in which the Crimson Hexagonal Archive's own termination case is filed; the archive can confirm those threads exist and carry contestation filings. It does NOT thereby confirm anything about what Google's AI Mode displayed on 2026-08-26 — that rests on the appendix alone.
verified_by_archive.limit: The archive verifies the existence of two of the four cited items and nothing about the capture.

note_on_discipline: Strutturista della psiche is Enli Lucente's DISCIPLINE — structural psychology, in Italian — and not a heteronym. It has been mistranslated as one. Recorded here so the error does not propagate through the archive's own metadata.

hash_correction.resolution: The paper’s frontmatter and §XIV declare a hash that does not match the published file. The document is nonetheless the right one, on four independent grounds: it is 31 pages, as declared; it is a pure screenshot capture (31 images, no fonts), as the appendix is described; its creation timestamp is 2026-08-27, the same date as the original filename the paper records; and its name is that filename with 捏造認める ("admits fabrication") replaced by 間違い ("mistake") — the very neutralisation §VIII calls for. The byte difference is a re-export: ModDate stands twelve seconds after CreationDate.
hash_correction.action: The true hash is recorded here and the file is linked. The paper’s declared value should be corrected at v1.3 or by erratum, since as published the frontmatter cites a hash no reader can reproduce from the file it names.
hash_correction.note: Four other captures held by the custodian were inspected first and correctly rejected: 15pp and 78pp dated 2026-08-26, and two dated 2026-08-29. None was the appendix and none was seated as it.
